title: Unique Roasted German Potatoes Roast
description: A fresh and crumbly German dish featuring allspice, perfect for the monsoon season, this flexitarian-friendly recipe is a must try. It combines the flavors of roasted potatoes, onions, and bell peppers with a hint of allspice.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the cubed potatoes, chopped onion, and chopped bell pepper.
In a small bowl, mix together the allspice, olive oil, salt, black pepper, and garlic powder.
Pour the spice mixture over the potato mixture and toss to coat.
Spread the potato mixture out in a single layer on a large baking sheet.
Roast the potatoes in the preheated oven for 30 minutes.
Stir the potatoes and continue to roast for an additional 20 minutes, or until they are tender and golden brown.
Remove the potatoes from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes before serving.
